title: The Mystery of Fog Island
author: Antigravity Detective Agency
description: An interactive mystery on a stormy, isolated island where every choice changes your fate.

scenes.title: The Foggy Pier
scenes.content: A heavy fog clings to the wooden planks of Blackwood Island's lonely dock. The ferry engine fades into the mist behind you. Before you, a worn wooden sign points toward 'The Shingle Beach', while a steep cliff path winds up toward the 'Old Lighthouse'.

choices.text: Inspect the rocky shoreline near the beach
Climb the cliff path toward the lighthouse

scenes.title: The Shingle Beach
scenes.content: Wet pebbles crunch underfoot. Tucked beneath an overturned wooden dinghy, you spot a sturdy brass storm lantern.

choices.text: Pick up the storm lantern
Head back to the dock

scenes.title: The Shingle Beach (Searched)
scenes.content: With the storm lantern now in your hand, the dark shadows around the cliff base seem slightly less menacing. A narrow cave entrance is visible higher up the rocky ridge.

choices.text: Venture into the dark cave entrance
Walk up toward the lighthouse

scenes.title: Whispering Caves
scenes.content: The lantern casts dancing shadows across wet limestone walls. Deep inside, you uncover an abandoned smuggler's camp. A captain's sea chest sits on a makeshift desk, and behind a curtain of stalagmites rests an ironbound strongbox.

choices.text: Study the suspicious logbook entries on the desk
Pry open the ironbound strongbox in the alcove
Leave the cave and hurry to the lighthouse

scenes.title: The Smuggler's Strongbox
scenes.content: Inside the strongbox is an ornate collection of stolen coastal merchant silver stamped with the keeper's personal family crest! Whoever lured ships onto the rocks was hoarding the salvage right here.

choices.text: Examine the ship logbook on the desk
Pocket the evidence and climb the path to the lighthouse

scenes.title: The Smuggler's Clue
scenes.content: The handwriting in the captain's log matches the official maintenance ledger from the island lighthouse! The wreckages were deliberate sabotage.

choices.text: Pry open the ironbound strongbox in the shadowy alcove
Confront the keeper at the lighthouse

scenes.title: The Lighthouse Footpath
scenes.content: Wind howls around the cliffside tower. Yellow light filters through the rain-streaked windows. The entrance door sits slightly ajar, while an observation catwalk overlooks the reef below.

choices.text: Push open the heavy door and step inside
Inspect the reef lookout before entering
Return to the beach below

scenes.title: The Reef Overlook
scenes.content: From the catwalk, you observe a mirror apparatus rigged to deflect the warning beam away from the jagged reef shoals! Even without written logs, the physical sabotage is plain to see.

choices.text: Step inside the keeper's quarters with your observations

scenes.title: Lighthouse Keeper's Quarters
scenes.content: An elderly keeper in a rain slicker turns around sharply. His eyes dart toward the spiral staircase leading up to the beacon. 'Visitors aren't supposed to be on Blackwood Island tonight,' he mutters coldly.

choices.text: Present the logbook evidence and accuse him of intentionally wrecking ships
Place the stolen family silver on the table and demand an explanation
Offer to help inspect and restore the malfunctioning beacon light for tonight's gale
Accuse him outright without concrete proof
Keep quiet about the mystery and politely ask for shelter until morning

scenes.title: Justice in the Tempest
scenes.content: Faced with the undeniable evidence in the logbook, the keeper confesses. You secure the beacon, restore the warning light, and radio the authorities at sunrise.

ending.title: The Mastermind Exposed
ending.description: You gathered decisive proof and solved the island mystery.

scenes.title: The Stolen Silver Exposed
scenes.content: Seeing his own engraved silver laid upon the table, the keeper breaks down in remorse. He surrenders the lighthouse keys, agrees to restore the beacon, and pledges full restitution to the merchant families.

ending.title: The Smuggler's Silver Recovered
ending.description: You uncovered the stolen silver treasure and brought about a peaceful, just confession.

scenes.title: Guardian of the Beacon
scenes.content: Putting suspicions aside, you scale the tower together and realign the shattered focal lenses. As the warning beam cuts through the storm, the midnight freighter passes safely. You kept watch until dawn, saving dozens of lives.

ending.title: The Beacon Restored
ending.description: You prioritized saving lives during the tempest, guiding the ships safely through the shoals.

scenes.title: Trapped in the Tower
scenes.content: Without proof, the keeper easily brushes aside your accusations. He knocks your lantern away, locks you inside the storm cellar, and flees into the storm.

ending.title: Silenced in the Dark
ending.description: Accusing without evidence left you vulnerable.

scenes.title: Ferry at Dawn
scenes.content: The keeper suspiciously lets you wait out the storm by the hearth. When the dawn ferry returns, you leave Blackwood Island with the truth still buried in the fog.

ending.title: The Unsolved Fog
ending.description: You survived the night, but the mystery remains unsolved.
